name: Shanghai Bolex Food Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Shanghai Bolex Food Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, production, and sales of condiments and pre-cooked food in China and internationally. The company's products portfolio includes compound seasonings, light cooking sauce packets, light cooking soup packets, and other light cooking solutions, as well as beverage and dessert ingredients comprising jams, popping beads, crystal balls, and tapioca pearls. The company offers its products under various categories, such as breading, bread crumbs, marinades, dusting powder, seasoning sauces, salad dressings, jams, seasoning packets, prepared food products, canned fruits and vegetables, baking premixes, and ready-to-drink be…
